Interactive Maps
Clermont County History Storymap, General Online Maps, Ohio River Flood Stages, Road Closures & Detours, Engineer Mapping, Places and Spaces, 2010 Census Boundaries, Low-Moderate Income Areas by Census Boundaries, and Data Download Map
Order Printed Maps or Data
Custom GIS maps are generally printed on 24″ x 36″ paper and include all the following layers unless otherwise specified: Roads, Property Lines, Streams, County Water & Sewer (if available) and 2′ contours
Downloads
Visit our Downloads page where you’ll find various data sets including Address Points, Municipal Boundaries, Parks, Railroads, Voting Precincts and Zoning.
